text.tspan: S3 security: who can access an object?
Block Public Access: ON by default for new buckets (can be set at account level too).
Leave it on unless the bucket must be public (e.g. static website).
An IAM principal can access an object if (its IAM policy ALLOWS it OR the resource policy ALLOWS it) AND there is no explicit DENY.
Cross-account: the bucket policy must allow the other account AND that account's IAM policy must allow its user.
• Action: set of APIs to allow or deny
• Principal: the account or user it applies to ("*" = anyone)
• grant public access to the bucket
• force objects to be encrypted at upload
